faqs.q: Does Windows 11 Pro unlock BitLocker drive encryption and Hyper-V virtualization?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro edition unlocks full BitLocker disk encryption, Hyper-V virtual machines, Windows Sandbox, Remote Desktop (RDP host), and Group Policy Editor.

faqs.q: Can I use this product key for clean installations via official Microsoft USB media?
faqs.a: Yes. You can type the 25-digit key during fresh installation using an official Microsoft Windows Media Creation Tool USB flash drive.

faqs.q: Is an active internet connection required during activation?
faqs.a: Yes. Windows requires an active internet connection to communicate with Microsoft activation servers to validate the digital certificate.
